images.prompt: Korean webtoon / manhwa style fashion lookbook illustration. Clean thin digital line art, soft cel shading, realistic fabric textures. Warm ivory plain background. Upper area: the two key items drawn alone as clean product illustrations with no person, side by side with a large simple plus sign between them: a cream half-zip chunky wool knit sweater + charcoal gray pinstripe wide-leg wool trousers; they sit between 18 and 40 percent of the image height. Lower area (the half-zip collar with its zipper is clearly visible on all four figures): the SAME young East Asian woman with a low ponytail shown FOUR times side by side, full body head to toe, small in the frame (heads around 44 percent, feet near 94 percent), slightly overlapping, each wearing the same two key items but styled differently: (1) a black tailored blazer worn over the sweater, black penny loafers, black leather tote bag; (2) white shirt collar layered out from the half-zip neck, small silver hoop earrings, burgundy loafers; (3) a beige trench coat draped loosely over the shoulders like a cape with both arms OUTSIDE the sleeves and the empty sleeves hanging, clean white leather sneakers; (4) a navy silk scarf tied at the neck, black ankle boots, small black shoulder bag. Different natural candid poses (walking, holding coffee, looking at phone, glancing over shoulder). Tall slender 8-heads proportions. The top 16 percent is empty plain background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. Vertical composition.
